module_summary: Five-state Moore FSM with synchronous-reset 3-bit state register and table-driven next state on x, asserting z in states D and E.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 3-bit Moore state register A-E, decoded into output z.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Moore output high in states D or E.

groups.name: fsm
groups.description: State register, next-state table on x, and output decode for z.
